subject: Different dependency graphs for the same model

messages.author: 42eec6aa1e70a8d1
messages.subject: Different dependency graphs for the same model
parts:
Hi,

The following two models are equivalent but are giving different dependency graphs (and hence very different results using MCMC). Any insight on why this is happening will be very helpful.

Thanks,
Abhi

library(nimble)

onedagarCode <- nimbleCode({
    w[1] ~ dnorm(0, invsigmasq)
    y[1] ~ dnorm(inprod(X[1, 1:p], beta[1:p]) + w[1], invtausq)
    for (i in 2:n){
        weight <- rho/(1+(dni[i-1]-1)*rho^2)
        
        mw <- w[i-1]                        
        w[i] ~ dnorm(mw*weight, invsigmasq*(1+(dni[i-1]-1)*rho^2)/(1-rho^2))     #### difference with the second model, mw is specified first and then used in the mean of w[i]
        
        y[i] ~ dnorm(inprod(X[i, 1:p], beta[1:p]) + w[i], invtausq)
    }
    beta[] ~ dmnorm(mubeta[],cholesky=Cbeta[,], prec_param=0)
    invsigmasq ~ dgamma(2, rate=1)
    invtausq ~ dgamma(2, rate=0.2)
    rho ~dunif(0,1)
})

onedagarCode2 <- nimbleCode({
    w[1] ~ dnorm(0, invsigmasq)
    y[1] ~ dnorm(inprod(X[1, 1:p], beta[1:p]) + w[1], invtausq)
    for (i in 2:n){
        weight <- rho/(1+(dni[i-1]-1)*rho^2)
        
        w[i] ~ dnorm(w[i-1]*weight, invsigmasq*(1+(dni[i-1]-1)*rho^2)/(1-rho^2))     #### difference with the first model, mean of w[i] is specified directly
        
        y[i] ~ dnorm(inprod(X[i, 1:p], beta[1:p]) + w[i], invtausq)
    }
    beta[] ~ dmnorm(mubeta[],cholesky=Cbeta[,], prec_param=0)
    invsigmasq ~ dgamma(2, rate=1)
    invtausq ~ dgamma(2, rate=0.2)
    rho ~dunif(0,1)
})

n=100
dni=rep(1,99)

onedagarModel <- nimbleModel(onedagarCode, constants = list(n = n, mubeta=c(0,0), 
    Cbeta=100*identityMatrix(2),zero=rep(0,n),p=2,dni=dni),dimensions=list(y=n, X=c(n,2), 
     beta=2,mubeta=2, Cbeta=c(2,2)), check=FALSE)
